title: [IMP-12] SFU signaling protocol is undefined
description: Review finding IMP-12: SFU signaling protocol is undefined (lens IMP). Location: spec/06-calls.md:84-119. Fix: As proposed. Also 06:88 says "the SFU's signaling messages are signed by the DID in that entry", but no signature format exists, and 06:111 says the client "presents the MLS-membership access proof", with no challenge or replay rule. Full text: notes/review/IMP-verified.md and notes/review/IMP.md.
close_reason: FIXED per notes/review/reconciliation.md: spec/06-calls.md §6.6 "SFU Signaling Protocol": WebSocket subprotocol agora-sfu.v1, full CDDL message set, challenge/nonce admission with admissionSig over sfu-admission (ctx "agora sfu admission", 30 s, single-use nonce), SDP signed as urn:agora:type:SfuDescription envelope per §13.1.1 bound to cli
